messages:
Priya V: Valencia sys asked for a concise perf/W exploration + kernel tuning playbook. Scope: 3 power caps (50/70/90W), two quant modes, and a small kernel flags grid. They want reproducible CSVs and a one-page partner summary.

Jon K: I'll own the harness and metric alignment. we should standardize on watt_avg, p50/p95, seq/s, and kv_hit. also include sample_rate=250ms timestamps.

Tomas H: Ops note : pin microcode v2026-02-10, bios conservatively set. we'll run vendor-kernel on two controls and our tuned kernel across test nodes.

Rae L: For kernel flags I propose: baseline (stock), memprefetch=off+hugepages=on, and our latency bundle (noprefetch=1 cpufreq=performance rcu_boost=1). I'll share flags file.

Jon K: draft command:
```bash
./partner-bench --model_glob glimmer-6b --batches 1,2,4 --seq 512 --quant q8,q4_0 \\
  --power-cap 50,70,90 --kernel-sets baseline,memprefetch,latency \\
  --telemetry nvml,rapl,pmu --telemetry-interval 250 \\
  --out s3://redwood-partner-bench/valencia/<run>/ \\
  --trace ndjson --meta partner=valencia
```

Priya V: good. Valencia asked we include a short reproducibility section (exact kernel cmdline + bios + microcode). Add md5 of the run artifacts.

bench-bot: scheduled run valencia-20260503-01 on 2026-05-03T07:00:00Z across 6 nodes. live logs: https://bench.redwood.internal/valencia-20260503-01

Tomas H: provisioning complete. pinned BIOS, microcode, and set node labels. control nodes running vendor-5.19.9. capturing inlet temp and rack probe.

Jon K: uploaded CSV schema and example at s3://redwood-partner-bench/valencia/schema/v1.csv and s3://.../examples/plot.png

Rae L: flags file -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/valencia/kernels/flags-v1.yaml (includes exact cmdlines).

bench-bot: job valencia-20260503-01/2 finished: batch=2 quant=q4_0 power_cap=70 avg_watt=69.8 p50=22.1 p95=48.9 seq_s=11.7 kv_hit=0.88. artifacts -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/valencia/valencia-20260503-01/results/part-0002.ndjson

Priya V: initial quick look: at 70W our latency bundle improved p95 ~10% vs baseline and improved seq/s by ~4%. will run full aggregations.

Jon K: running bootstrap CI now; will post delta_Throughput@70W and p95 improvements with 95% CI.

Tomas H: note: node-4 had elevated inlet (3C higher). excluding it from final aggregate. retest scheduled on spare node tonight.

bench-bot: job valencia-20260503-01/5 failed (node-4): thermal trip throttle events. dmesg saved -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/valencia/valencia-20260503-01/node-4-dmesg.log

Rae L: uploaded combined plots and a draft one-pager (internal) to s3://redwood-partner-bench/valencia/publish/draft-1.pdf. It highlights delta_Throughput@70W and per-kernel p95 table.

Jon K: aggregates done. delta_Throughput@70W = +4.2% (95% CI: 1.8%-6.6%). p95 improved -10.8% (95% CI: -14.5% to -7.1%).

Priya V: solid. Rae, please prep the partner-facing one-pager with the reproducibility appendix. We'll gate any marketplace claim until Valencia legal signs off.

Tomas H: retest node-4 ran clean on spare and results added. updated CSV at s3://.../aggregates/final.csv

bench-bot: run valencia-20260503-01 completed. final artifacts: s3://redwood-partner-bench/valencia/valencia-20260503-01/final.zip

Priya V: schedule sync with Valencia for Thu 14:00 UTC to walk through findings and the one-pager. Thanks team. Action items: Jon (final stats + CI table), Rae (partner one-pager + reproducibility appendix), Tomas (node validation), bench-bot (make final artifacts public to partners after legal OK).

Jon K: ack.
